name: python-fastapi-service
description: A minimal FastAPI HTTP service scaffold with a health endpoint, pytest + TestClient tests, hash-locked dependencies, optional Docker support, and optional Jenkins pipeline support.
recommended_use: Use for HTTP services and adapters that need a real ASGI web framework -- for example an OIDC/identity adapter -- where python-worker's minimal, quickly-returning main() is not a fit.
smoke_test_command: set -e; test -f pyproject.toml; test -f requirements.lock; test -f requirements-dev.lock; test -f .env.example; test -f src/python_fastapi_service_validate_smoke/main.py; test -f tests/test_smoke.py; grep -q 'app = FastAPI(' src/python_fastapi_service_validate_smoke/main.py; grep -q '/healthz' src/python_fastapi_service_validate_smoke/main.py; grep -q 'from python_fastapi_service_validate_smoke.main import app' tests/test_smoke.py; grep -q 'TestClient' tests/test_smoke.py; echo python-fastapi-service smoke ok
